props.description: How the line joins its points; `monotone` by default.
props.name: curve

props.description: Marks each point with a dot; off by default.
props.name: showDots

props.description: The key of each row's category: a month name, an ISO date.
props.name: xKey

props.description: Writes the category as a date in the locale (`{ month: "short" }`); categories are shown as given without it.
props.name: xFormat

props.description: Stacks the series on one another; side by side (bars) or overlapping (areas, lines) by default.
props.name: stacked

props.description:
With `stacked`, stacks each category to 100%: every series is drawn as its share of the category's total and the
value axis reads in percent (area and bar charts). The tooltip and data table keep the real values.
props.name: isNormalized

props.description: Draws the horizontal grid lines; on by default.
props.name: showGrid

props.description: Draws the value axis; off by default, since the tooltip and the data table carry the values.
props.name: showValueAxis

props.description: Target lines and threshold bands on the value axis, drawn behind the series.
props.name: references

props.description: Draws each series' `compareKey` values as a dashed twin: the previous period beside this one. Off by default.
props.name: showComparison

props.description:
Adds a brush under the plot to zoom into a span of the categories (web line, area and composed charts; native
reads every row and ignores it). Off by default.
props.name: showBrush

props.description: The rows, in reading order.
props.name: data
props.type: readonly Readonly<Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>>[]

props.description: The series drawn, in legend order.
props.name: series

props.description: The chart's accessible name and the data table's caption, such as "Visitors, last six months".
props.name: label

props.description: The colours series take by position: `accent` steps (the default) or the `categorical` set.
props.name: palette

props.description: How values are written: `{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }`, `{ notation: "compact" }`.
props.name: valueFormat

props.description: The plot's height in pixels; 240 by default.
props.name: height

props.description: Shows the legend under the plot; on by default when there are two series or more.
props.name: showLegend

props.description: Shows the values of the pointed or pressed row; on by default.
props.name: showTooltip
